system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: github-actions-workload-identity-pool
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ env['project'] }}/locations/global
    workloadIdentityPoolId: github-actions-pool
    displayName: GitHub Actions Workload Identity Pool
    description: Workload Identity Pool for GitHub Actions
    state: ACTIVE

- name: github-actions-workload-identity-provider
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools.providers
  properties:
    parent: $(ref.github-actions-workload-identity-pool.name)
    workloadIdentityProviderId: github-actions-provider
    displayName: GitHub Actions Workload Identity Provider
    description: Workload Identity Provider for GitHub Actions
    state: ACTIVE
    oidc:
      issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      allowedAudiences:
      - projects/{{ env['project'] }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github-actions-pool/providers/github-actions-provider
    attributeMapping:
      google.subject: assertion.sub
      attribute.actor: assertion.actor
      attribute.repository: assertion.repository
      attribute.repository_owner: assertion.repository_owner
      attribute.workflow: assertion.workflow
      attribute.run_id: assertion.run_id
      attribute.run_attempt: assertion.run_attempt

- name: github-actions-service-account
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    accountId: github-actions-sa
    displayName: GitHub Actions Service Account
    description: Service account for GitHub Actions deployments

- name: github-actions-service-account-binding
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts.iam
  properties:
    resource: projects/{{ env['project'] }}/serviceAccounts/$(ref.github-actions-service-account.email)
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
        members:
        - principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/$(ref.github-actions-workload-identity-pool.name)/attribute.repository/{{ properties['githubRepository'] }}
      - role: roles/run.admin
        members:
        - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-actions-service-account.email)
      - role: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
        members:
        - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-actions-service-account.email)
      - role: roles/storage.objectViewer
        members:
        - serviceAccount:$(ref.github-actions-service-account.email)

outputs:
- name: workload_identity_pool_name
  value: $(ref.github-actions-workload-identity-pool.name)
- name: workload_identity_provider_name
  value: $(ref.github-actions-workload-identity-provider.name)
- name: service_account_email
  value: $(ref.github-actions-service-account.email)
